translations.literal: The Zhou system of left altar of soil and right ancestral temple was changed to right altar of soil and left ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou system of left altar of soil and right ancestral temple was changed to right altar of soil and left ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 遣八使巡省風俗。

translations.literal: Eight envoys were dispatched to tour and inspect local customs.
translations.idiomatic: Eight envoys were sent to tour and inspect local customs.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，修廟社。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the ancestral temple and altar of soil were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the ancestral temple and altar of soil were repaired.

sentences.zh: 立王后獨孤氏為皇后，王太子勇為皇太子。

translations.literal: The queen consort Lady Dugu was established as empress, and the crown prince Yong as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Queen consort Lady Dugu was established as empress, and crown prince Yong as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以大將軍趙蟹為尚書右僕射，以上開府伊婁彥恭為右武候大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Grand General Zhao Xie was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Upper Palace Gate General Yilou Yiangong was made General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Grand General Zhao Xie became Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Upper Palace Gate General Yilou Yiangong became General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以五千戶封周帝介國公為隋室賓；

translations.literal: On the day jisi, five thousand households were granted to enfeoff the Zhou emperor, Duke of Jie, as guest of the House of Sui;
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day five thousand households were granted to enfeoff the Zhou emperor, Duke of Jie, as guest of the House of Sui;

sentences.zh: 旌旗車服禮樂，一如其舊；

translations.literal: banners, carriages, robes, and ritual music were all as before;
translations.idiomatic: banners, carriages, robes, and ritual music remained as before;

sentences.zh: 上書不為表，答表不稱詔。

translations.literal: memorials upward were not called tables, and replies to tables were not called edicts.
translations.idiomatic: memorials upward were not called tables, and replies to tables were not called edicts.

sentences.zh: 周氏諸王，盡降為公。

translations.literal: All Zhou princes were reduced to dukes.
translations.idiomatic: All Zhou princes were reduced to dukes.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以皇弟同安郡公爽為雍州牧。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the imperial younger brother Duke Shuang of Tong'an Commandery was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the imperial younger brother Duke Shuang of Tong'an Commandery became Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，封皇弟邵國公慧為滕王，同安公爽為衛王，皇子雁門公廣為晉王，俊為秦王，秀為越王，諒為漢王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the imperial younger brother Duke Hui of Shao was enfeoffed Prince of Teng, Duke Shuang of Tong'an as Prince of Wei, the prince Duke Guang of Yanmen as Prince of Jin, Jun as Prince of Qin, Xiu as Prince of Yue, and Liang as Prince of Han.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the imperial younger brother Duke Hui of Shao was enfeoffed Prince of Teng, Duke Shuang of Tong'an as Prince of Wei, Prince Guang of Yanmen as Prince of Jin, Jun as Prince of Qin, Xiu as Prince of Yue, and Liang as Prince of Han.

sentences.zh: 并州總管李穆為太師，上柱國竇熾為太傅，幽州總管於翼為太尉，觀國公田仁恭為太子太師，武德郡公柳敏為太子太保。

translations.literal: Area Commander of Bing Province Li Mu was made Grand Preceptor; Pillar of State Dou Chi was made Grand Tutor; Area Commander of You Province Yu Yi was made Grand Commandant; Duke Tian Rengong of Guan was made Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince; Duke Liu Min of Wude Commandery was made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mu, Area Commander of Bing Province, became Grand Preceptor; Pillar of State Dou Chi became Grand Tutor; Yu Yi, Area Commander of You Province, became Grand Commandant; Duke Tian Rengong of Guan became Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince; and Duke Liu Min of Wude Commandery became Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以晉王廣為并州總管，封陳留郡公智積為蔡王，興城郡公靜為道王。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Prince Guang of Jin was made Area Commander of Bing Province; Duke Zhiji of Chenliu Commandery was enfeoffed Prince of Cai, and Duke Jing of Xingcheng Commandery Prince of Dao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Guang of Jin became Area Commander of Bing Province; Duke Zhiji of Chenliu Commandery was enfeoffed Prince of Cai, and Duke Jing of Xingcheng Commandery Prince of Dao.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，改東京府為尚書省，發官牛五千頭，分賜貧人。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the Eastern Capital office was changed to the Department of State Affairs; five thousand government oxen were distributed to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Eastern Capital office became the Department of State Affairs; five thousand government oxen were distributed to the poor.

sentences.zh: 三月，宣仁門槐樹連理，眾枝內附。

translations.literal: In the third month, the sophora tree at Xuanren Gate joined branches in mutual embrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the sophora tree at Xuanren Gate joined branches in mutual embrace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，白狼國獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the White Wolf State presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the White Wolf State presented local products.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔犬馬器玩口味，不得獻上。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict ordered that dogs, horses, utensils, playthings, and delicacies must not be presented upward.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict ordered that dogs, horses, utensils, playthings, and delicacies must not be presented upward.

sentences.zh: 戊子，弛山澤禁。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, prohibitions on mountains and marshes were relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day prohibitions on mountains and marshes were relaxed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，移盩啡連理樹植於宮庭。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the joined sophora tree of Zhouzhi was transplanted in the palace courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the joined sophora tree of Zhouzhi was transplanted in the palace courtyard.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以太子少保蘇威兼納言、吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince Su Wei was made Concurrent Censor-in-Chief and Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince Su Wei became Concurrent Censor-in-Chief and Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔前代品爵，悉依舊定。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, an edict ordered that ranks and titles of former dynasties all follow the old determinations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict ordered that ranks and titles of former dynasties all follow the old determinations.

sentences.zh: 丁未，梁蕭巋使其太宰蕭巖來賀。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Xiao Yan of Liang sent his Grand Preceptor Xiao Yan to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Xiao Yan of Liang sent his Grand Preceptor Xiao Yan to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，大赦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day xinsi, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on xinsi day, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太常散樂並免為編戶。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Director of Ceremonies' scattered performers were all released to become registered households.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Director of Ceremonies' scattered performers were all released to become registered households.

sentences.zh: 禁雜樂百戲。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous music and hundred entertainments were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous music and hundred entertainments were prohibited.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，陳人來聘於周，至而上已受禪，致之介國。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, men of Chen came on a friendly mission to Zhou; when they arrived the Emperor had already received the abdication, and they were sent to the Duke of Jie.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day men of Chen came on a friendly mission to Zhou; when they arrived the Emperor had already received the abdication, and they were sent to the Duke of Jie.

sentences.zh: 是月，發稽胡修恐長城，二旬而罷。

translations.literal: That month, Jiehu were mobilized to repair the Great Wall; after twenty days the work ceased.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jiehu were mobilized to repair the Great Wall; after twenty days the work ceased.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，封邗國公楊雄為廣平王，永康郡公楊弘為河間王。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu of the fifth month, Duke Xiong of Hang was enfeoffed Prince of Guangping, and Duke Hong of Yongkang Commandery Prince of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the fifth month Duke Xiong of Hang was enfeoffed Prince of Guangping, and Duke Hong of Yongkang Commandery Prince of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 辛未，介公薨，上舉哀於朝堂，謚曰周靜帝。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the Duke of Jie died; the Emperor mourned at the court hall; posthumous title: Emperor Jing of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Duke of Jie died; the Emperor mourned at the court hall; posthumous title: Emperor Jing of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，詔以初受命，赤雀降祥，推五德相生，為火色。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei of the sixth month, an edict ordered that because at first receiving the mandate the red sparrow descended as an omen, following the mutual generation of the Five Virtues, red was taken as the dynastic color.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei of the sixth month an edict ordered that because at first receiving the mandate the red sparrow descended as an omen, following the mutual generation of the Five Virtues, red was taken as the dynastic color.

sentences.zh: 其郊及社、廟，依服冕之儀；

translations.literal: For suburban and altar-of-soil and temple rites, the robes of investiture were followed;
translations.idiomatic: For suburban and altar-of-soil and temple rites, the robes of investiture were followed;

sentences.zh: 而朝會之服、旗幟、犧牲盡尚赤，戎服尚黃。

translations.literal: but court robes, banners, and sacrificial victims all honored red, and military robes honored yellow.
translations.idiomatic: but court robes, banners, and sacrificial victims all honored red, and military robes honored yellow.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，上始服黃，百僚畢賀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day yimao, the Emperor first wore yellow; the hundred officials all offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on yimao day, the Emperor first wore yellow; the hundred officials all offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，廢東京官。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the eighth month, the Eastern Capital office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the eighth month the Eastern Capital office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣樂安公元諧擊吐谷渾於青海，破而降之。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Prince Yuan of Le'an was dispatched to attack Tuyuhun at Qinghai, defeated them, and accepted their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Prince Yuan of Le'an was sent to attack Tuyuhun at Qinghai, defeated them, and accepted their surrender.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，遣使振給戰亡者家。

translations.literal: On the day wushen of the ninth month, envoys were dispatched to give relief to the families of those who died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the ninth month envoys were sent to give relief to the families of those who died in battle.

sentences.zh: 庚午，陳將周羅攻陷胡墅，蕭摩訶寇江北。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the Chen general Zhou Luohou took Hushi, and Xiao Mohe raided north of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Chen general Zhou Luohou took Hushi, and Xiao Mohe raided north of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以越王秀為益州總管，改封蜀王。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Prince Xiu of Yue was made Area Commander of Yi Province and changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Prince Xiu of Yue became Area Commander of Yi Province and was changed in enfeoffment to Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以薛公長孫覽、宋安公元景山並為行軍元帥。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Duke Changsun Lan of Xue and Prince Yuan Jingshan of Song'an were both made campaign supreme commanders.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Duke Changsun Lan of Xue and Prince Yuan Jingshan of Song'an were both made campaign supreme commanders.

sentences.zh: 伐陳，仍令尚書左僕射高譫節度諸軍。

translations.literal: They attacked Chen, and Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Gao Jiong was still ordered to command all armies.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Chen, and Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Gao Jiong was still ordered to command all armies.

sentences.zh: 是月，行五銖錢。

translations.literal: That month, the five-zhu coin was put into circulation.
translations.idiomatic: That month the five-zhu coin was put into circulation.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，百濟王扶余昌遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day yiyou, King Buyu Chang of Baekje sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on yiyou day, King Buyu Chang of Baekje sent envoys to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 授昌上開府儀同三司、帶方郡公。

translations.literal: Chang was appointed Upper Palace Gate General, Third Rank Equivalent, and Duke of Daifang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Chang was appointed Upper Palace Gate General, Third Rank Equivalent, and Duke of Daifang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 戊子，行新律。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the new law code was put into effect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the new law code took effect.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，行幸岐州。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the Emperor traveled to Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the Emperor traveled to Qi Province.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，以永富郡公竇榮定為右武候大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day yimao of the eleventh month, Duke Rongding of Yongfu, Dou Rongding, was made General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the eleventh month Duke Rongding of Yongfu, Dou Rongding, became General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 遣兼散騎侍郎鄭捴使於陳。

translations.literal: Acting Attendant Cavalier Zheng Ce was dispatched as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Attendant Cavalier Zheng Ce was sent as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 己巳，有流星如墜墻，光照於地。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, a meteor like a falling wall illuminated the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day a meteor like a falling wall illuminated the ground.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，以禮部尚書韋世康為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the twelfth month, Director of the Ministry of Rites Wei Shikang was made Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the twelfth month Director of the Ministry of Rites Wei Shikang became Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 庚子，至自岐州。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, he returned from Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day he returned from Qi Province.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，高麗王高陽遣使朝貢，授陽大將軍、遼東郡公。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, King Gao Yang of Goguryeo sent envoys to offer tribute; Yang was appointed Grand General and Duke of Liaodong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day King Gao Yang of Goguryeo sent envoys to offer tribute; Yang was appointed Grand General and Duke of Liaodong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 太子太保柳敏卒。

translations.literal: Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince Liu Min died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince Liu Min died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，靺鞨、突厥阿波可汗、沙缽略可汗並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Mohe, the Turkic Khan Apo, and the Turkic Khan Shabolue all sent envoys to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Mohe, Turkic Khan Apo, and Turkic Khan Shabolue all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚申，陳宣帝殂。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on the day gengshen, Emperor Xuan of Chen died.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year two, on gengshen of the first month, Emperor Xuan of Chen died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，置河北道行臺尚書省於并州，以晉王廣為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the Branch Department of State Affairs of Hebei Circuit was established at Bing Province, with Prince Guang of Jin as Director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Branch Department of State Affairs of Hebei Circuit was established at Bing Province, with Prince Guang of Jin as Director.

sentences.zh: 置河南道行臺尚書省於洛州，以秦王俊為尚書令。

translations.literal: The Branch Department of State Affairs of Henan Circuit was established at Luo Province, with Prince Jun of Qin as Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Department of State Affairs of Henan Circuit was established at Luo Province, with Prince Jun of Qin as Director.

sentences.zh: 置西南道行臺尚書省於益州，以蜀王秀為尚書令。

translations.literal: The Branch Department of State Affairs of Southwest Circuit was established at Yi Province, with Prince Xiu of Shu as Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Department of State Affairs of Southwest Circuit was established at Yi Province, with Prince Xiu of Shu as Director.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，陳人遣使請和，求歸胡墅。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, men of Chen sent envoys requesting peace and asking for the return of Hushi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day men of Chen sent envoys requesting peace and asking for the return of Hushi.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔舉賢良。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, an edict ordered the recommendation of worthy and good men.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict ordered the recommendation of worthy and good men.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，詔以陳有喪，命高颎等班師。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the second month, an edict ordered that because Chen was in mourning, Gao Jiong and others were to withdraw their armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the second month an edict ordered that because Chen was in mourning, Gao Jiong and others were to withdraw their armies.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，加晉王廣左武衛大將軍，秦王俊右武衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Prince Guang of Jin was given the additional post of General of the Left Martial Guard, and Prince Jun of Qin General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Guang of Jin received the additional post of General of the Left Martial Guard, and Prince Jun of Qin General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 庚子，京師雨土。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, earth rained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day earth rained in the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月，初命入宮殿門通籍。

translations.literal: In the third month, for the first time entry to palace gates with registry passes was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month entry to palace gates with registry passes was ordered for the first time.

sentences.zh: 戊申，開渠引柱陽水於三畤原。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, a canal was opened to bring Zhuyang water to Sanchi Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day a canal was opened to bring Zhuyang water to Sanchi Plain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，以寧州刺史竇榮定為左武候大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou of the fourth month of summer, Governor of Ning Province Dou Rongding was made General of the Left Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the fourth summer month Governor of Ning Province Dou Rongding became General of the Left Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大將軍韓僧壽破突厥於雞頭山，上柱國李充破突厥於河北山。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Grand General Han Sengshou defeated the Turks at Jitou Mountain; Pillar of State Li Chong defeated the Turks at Hebei Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Grand General Han Sengshou defeated the Turks at Jitou Mountain; Pillar of State Li Chong defeated the Turks at Hebei Mountain.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，以上開府長孫平為度支尚書。

translations.literal: On the day wushen of the fifth month, Upper Palace Gate General Changsun Ping was made Director of the Ministry of Taxation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the fifth month Upper Palace Gate General Changsun Ping became Director of the Ministry of Taxation.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以旱故，上親省囚徒，其日大雨。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, because of drought the Emperor personally reviewed prisoners; that day great rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, because of drought the Emperor personally reviewed prisoners; that day great rain fell.

sentences.zh: 己未，高寶寧寇平州，突厥入長城。

translations.literal: On the day wuwei, Gao Baoning raided Ping Province and the Turks entered the Great Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwei day Gao Baoning raided Ping Province and the Turks entered the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以豫州刺史皇甫績為都官尚書。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Governor of Yu Province Huangfu Ji was made Director of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Governor of Yu Province Huangfu Ji became Director of the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 甲子，改傳國璽曰受命璽。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the imperial transfer seal was renamed the Seal of Receiving the Mandate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the imperial transfer seal was renamed the Seal of Receiving the Mandate.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，制人年六十以上免課。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, a regulation ordered that persons sixty years and older were exempt from tax and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day a regulation ordered that persons sixty years and older were exempt from tax and corvée.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，以太府卿蘇孝慈為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the sixth month, Director of the Imperial Treasury Su Xiaoci was made Director of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the sixth month Director of the Imperial Treasury Su Xiaoci became Director of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 甲申，使使吊於陳。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, envoys were sent to offer condolences in Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day envoys were sent to offer condolences in Chen.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上柱國李充破突厥於馬邑。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Pillar of State Li Chong defeated the Turks at Mayi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Pillar of State Li Chong defeated the Turks at Mayi.

sentences.zh: 丙申詔曰：朕祗奉上玄，群臨萬國。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen an edict said: I respectfully serve the Supreme Lord and face the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict said: I respectfully serve the Supreme Lord and face the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 屬生靈之弊，處前代之宮，以為作之者勞，居之者逸。

translations.literal: Because the people were exhausted, I dwell in the palace of the former dynasty, thinking that those who built it labored while those who dwell in it rest.
translations.idiomatic: Because the people were exhausted, I dwell in the palace of the former dynasty, thinking that those who built it labored while those who dwell in it rest.

sentences.zh: 改創之事，心未遑也。

translations.literal: Matters of rebuilding and creation my heart has not yet attended to.
translations.idiomatic: Matters of rebuilding and creation my heart has not yet attended to.

sentences.zh: 而王公大臣，陳謀獻策，咸云：羲、農以降，至於姬、劉，有當世而屢遷，無革命而不徙。

translations.literal: Yet kings, dukes, and ministers counseled and offered plans, all saying: From Xi and Nong onward, through Ji and Liu, there were repeated moves within a single age and no change without relocation.
translations.idiomatic: Yet kings, dukes, and ministers counseled and offered plans, all saying: From Xi and Nong onward, through Ji and Liu, there were repeated moves within a single age and no change without relocation.

sentences.zh: 曹、馬之後，時見因循，乃末世之宴安，非往聖之宏義。

translations.literal: After Cao and Ma, one often saw inertia; this was the ease of a decadent age, not the great meaning of former sages.
translations.idiomatic: After Cao and Ma, one often saw inertia; this was the ease of a decadent age, not the great meaning of former sages.

sentences.zh: 此城從漢，雕殘日久，屢為戰場，舊經喪亂。

translations.literal: This city dates from Han; long battered and ruined, it has repeatedly been a battlefield and often suffered disorder.
translations.idiomatic: This city dates from Han; long battered and ruined, it has repeatedly been a battlefield and often suffered disorder.

sentences.zh: 今之宮室，近代權宜，又非謀筮從龜，瞻星揆日；

translations.literal: The present palace buildings are recent expedients, and were not chosen by divination from tortoise shells or by observing stars and measuring the sun;
translations.idiomatic: The present palace buildings are recent expedients, and were not chosen by divination from tortoise shells or by observing stars and measuring the sun;

sentences.zh: 不足建皇王之邑，合大眾所聚。

translations.literal: they are insufficient to establish the seat of an imperial king or to gather the great multitude.
translations.idiomatic: they are insufficient to establish the seat of an imperial king or to gather the great multitude.

sentences.zh: 論變通之數，具幽顯之情。

translations.literal: The numbers of change and adaptation and the feelings of the hidden and manifest have been fully discussed.
translations.idiomatic: The numbers of change and adaptation and the feelings of the hidden and manifest have been fully discussed.

sentences.zh: 同心固請，詞情深切。

translations.literal: With one heart they firmly request; their words are deep and earnest.
translations.idiomatic: With one heart they firmly request; their words are deep and earnest.

sentences.zh: 然則京師百官之府，四海歸向，非朕一人之所獨有。

translations.literal: Yet the offices of the hundred officials in the capital and the turning of the four seas toward it are not mine alone to possess.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the offices of the hundred officials in the capital and the turning of the four seas toward it are not mine alone to possess.

sentences.zh: 茍利於物，其可違乎。

translations.literal: If it benefits things, how can it be refused?
translations.idiomatic: If it benefits things, how can it be refused?

sentences.zh: 且殷之五遷，恐人盡怨。

translations.literal: Moreover Yin moved its capital five times, fearing that the people would all resent it.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Yin moved its capital five times, fearing that the people would all resent it.

sentences.zh: 是則以吉凶之土，制長短之命，謀新去故，如農望秋：雖則劬勞，其究安宅。

translations.literal: Thus by the soil of fortune and misfortune one determines the length or shortness of fate; seeking the new and leaving the old is like a farmer looking toward autumn: though toilsome, in the end there is a settled home.
translations.idiomatic: Thus by the soil of fortune and misfortune one determines the length or shortness of fate; seeking the new and leaving the old is like a farmer looking toward autumn: though toilsome, in the end there is a settled home.

sentences.zh: 今區宇寧一，陰陽順序，安安以遷，勿懷胥怨。

translations.literal: Now the realm is unified and yin and yang are in order; move in peace and do not harbor mutual resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm is unified and yin and yang are in order; move in peace and do not harbor mutual resentment.

sentences.zh: 龍首山川原秀麗，卉物滋阜，卜食相土，宜建都邑。

translations.literal: The mountains, rivers, plains, and hills of Longshou are beautiful; plants and things flourish there; by divination for food and examination of soil, a capital city should be built.
translations.idiomatic: The mountains, rivers, plains, and hills of Longshou are beautiful; plants and things flourish there; by divination for food and examination of soil, a capital city should be built.

sentences.zh: 定鼎之基永固，無窮之業在斯。

translations.literal: The foundation of the fixed cauldron will be forever firm; the boundless enterprise lies herein.
translations.idiomatic: The foundation of the fixed cauldron will be forever firm; the boundless enterprise lies herein.

sentences.zh: 公私府宅，規模遠近，營構資須，隨事修茸。

translations.literal: For public and private residences and offices, whether near or far, construction materials should be supplied and repairs made as needed.
translations.idiomatic: For public and private residences and offices, whether near or far, construction materials should be supplied and repairs made as needed.

sentences.zh: 仍詔左僕射高颎、將作大匠劉龍、鉅鹿郡公賀婁子幹、太府少卿高龍叉等創造新都。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Gao Jiong, Master of Construction Liu Long, Duke He Lou Zigan of Julu Commandery, and Junior Director of the Imperial Treasury Gao Longcha were still ordered to create the new capital.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Gao Jiong, Master of Construction Liu Long, Duke He Lou Zigan of Julu Commandery, and Junior Director of the Imperial Treasury Gao Longcha were still ordered to create the new capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，詔新置都處墳墓，令悉遷葬設祭，仍給人功；

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the seventh month of autumn, an edict ordered that graves at the site of the new capital all be moved and reburied with sacrifices; labor was still provided;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered that graves at the site of the new capital all be moved and reburied with sacrifices; labor was still provided;

sentences.zh: 無主者，命官為殯葬。

translations.literal: for the unclaimed, officials were ordered to bury them.
translations.idiomatic: for the unclaimed, officials were ordered to bury them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，行新令。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the new ordinances were put into effect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the new ordinances took effect.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，以撤毀故，徙居東宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, because of demolition and destruction, he moved to dwell in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, because of demolition and destruction, he moved to dwell in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 給內外官人祿。

translations.literal: Salaries were granted to inner and outer officials.
translations.idiomatic: Salaries were granted to inner and outer officials.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，皇太子勇屯兵咸陽，以備胡虜。

translations.literal: On the day youyu, Crown Prince Yong encamped troops at Xianyang to guard against barbarian raiders.
translations.idiomatic: On youyu day Crown Prince Yong encamped troops at Xianyang to guard against barbarian raiders.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上疾愈，享百僚於觀德殿，賜錢帛，皆任自取，盡力以出。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, when the Emperor's illness was cured, he feasted the hundred officials at Guande Hall and granted cash and silk; each might take as much as he could carry out.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, when the Emperor's illness was cured, he feasted the hundred officials at Guande Hall and granted cash and silk; each might take as much as he could carry out.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以營新都副監賀婁子幹為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Deputy Supervisor of the New Capital He Lou Zigan was made Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Deputy Supervisor of the New Capital He Lou Zigan became Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，初命為方陣戰法，及制軍營圖樣，下諸軍府，以擬征突厥。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu of the eleventh month, for the first time square-array battle methods and camp diagrams were made and sent down to all military offices to prepare for campaigning against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the eleventh month square-array battle methods and camp diagrams were made for the first time and sent down to all military offices to prepare for campaigning against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，上講武於後園。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the twelfth month, the Emperor reviewed troops in the rear garden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the twelfth month the Emperor reviewed troops in the rear garden.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上柱國竇毅卒。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Pillar of State Dou Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Pillar of State Dou Yi died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，名新都曰大興城。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the new capital was named Daxing City.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the new capital was named Daxing City.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣彭城公虞慶則屯弘化以備胡。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Duke Yu Qingze of Pengcheng was dispatched to garrison Honghua to guard against the Hu.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Duke Yu Qingze of Pengcheng was sent to garrison Honghua to guard against the Hu.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇周盤，行軍總管達奚長儒為虜所敗。

translations.literal: The Turks raided Zhoupan; Campaign General Daxi Changru was defeated by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks raised Zhoupan; Campaign General Daxi Changru was defeated by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜國子生經明者束帛。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, silk was granted to students of the Directorate of Education who were versed in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day silk was granted to students of the Directorate of Education who were versed in the classics.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，親錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Emperor personally recorded prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor personally recorded prisoners.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、百濟並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo and Baekje both sent envoys to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo and Baekje both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子，將遷新都，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, on the day gengzi, as the new capital was about to be moved, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, first month, on gengzi day, as the new capital was about to be moved, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 禁大刀長。

translations.literal: Large swords and long spears were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: Large swords and long spears were prohibited.

sentences.zh: 始令人以二十一成丁，歲役功不過二十日，不役者收庸。

translations.literal: For the first time it was ordered that one in twenty-one adult males was a corvée worker, with labor service not exceeding twenty days per year; those not serving paid a substitute levy.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time it was ordered that one in twenty-one adult males was a corvée worker, with labor service not exceeding twenty days per year; those not serving paid a substitute levy.

sentences.zh: 廢遠近酒坊，罷鹽井禁。

translations.literal: Distant and nearby wine shops were abolished and salt-well prohibitions were lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Distant and nearby wine shops were abolished and salt-well prohibitions were lifted.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day jisi of the second month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the first day of the second month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day youyu, men of Chen came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On youyu day men of Chen came on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 突厥犯邊。

translations.literal: The Turks violated the border.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks violated the border.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以左武衛大將軍李禮成為右武衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, General of the Left Martial Guard Li Licheng was made General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day General of the Left Martial Guard Li Licheng became General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，上柱國、鮮虞縣公謝慶恩卒。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the third month, Pillar of State, Duke Xie Qing'en of Xianyu County, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei of the third month Pillar of State, Duke Xie Qing'en of Xianyu County, died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以雨故，常服入新都。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, because of rain he entered the new capital in ordinary dress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, because of rain he entered the new capital in ordinary dress.

sentences.zh: 京師承明裏醴泉出。

translations.literal: Sweet springs appeared in Chengming Lane in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet springs appeared in Chengming Lane in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔購遺書於天下。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict ordered the purchase of lost books throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered the purchase of lost books throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，城榆關。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Yugu Pass was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Yugu Pass was fortified.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，衛王爽大破突厥於白道山，停築原陽、雲內、紫河等鎮而還。

translations.literal: On the day jisi of the fourth month of summer, Prince Shuang of Wei greatly defeated the Turks at Baidao Mountain, ceased building the garrisons of Yuanyang, Yunnei, Zihe, and others, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the fourth summer month Prince Shuang of Wei greatly defeated the Turks at Baidao Mountain, ceased building the garrisons of Yuanyang, Yunnei, Zihe, and others, and returned.

sentences.zh: 上柱國、建平郡公於義卒。

translations.literal: Pillar of State, Duke Yi of Jianping Commandery, died.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar of State, Duke Yi of Jianping Commandery, died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，吐谷渾寇臨洮，洮州刺史皮子信死之。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Tuyuhun raided Lin Tao; Governor of Tao Province Pi Zixin died in the fight.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Tuyuhun raided Lin Tao; Governor of Tao Province Pi Zixin died in the fight.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以尚書右僕射趙煚兼內史令。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Zhao Jiong was made Concurrent Director of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Zhao Jiong became Concurrent Director of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以滕王瓚為雍州牧。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Prince Zan of Teng was made Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Zan of Teng became Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，行軍總管陰壽大破高寶寧於黃龍。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Campaign General Yin Shou greatly defeated Gao Baoning at Huanglong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Campaign General Yin Shou greatly defeated Gao Baoning at Huanglong.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以旱故，上親祀雨師。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, because of drought the Emperor personally sacrificed to the Rain Master.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, because of drought the Emperor personally sacrificed to the Rain Master.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔天下勸學行禮。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, an edict ordered the realm to encourage learning and practice ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict ordered the realm to encourage learning and practice ritual.

sentences.zh: 己丑，陳郢州城主張子譏遣使請降，上以和好不納。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Zhang Ziji, garrison commander of Ying Prefecture in Chen, sent envoys requesting surrender; the Emperor, for the sake of peace, did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhang Ziji, garrison commander of Ying Prefecture in Chen, sent envoys requesting surrender; the Emperor, for the sake of peace, did not accept.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣兼散騎常侍薛舒聘於陳。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Acting Attendant Cavalier Xue Shu was dispatched on a friendly mission to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Acting Attendant Cavalier Xue Shu was sent on a friendly mission to Chen.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上親雩。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the Emperor personally performed the rain sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Emperor personally performed the rain sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，太尉、任城公於翼薨。

translations.literal: On the day maoyin of the fifth month, Grand Commandant, Duke Yi of Rencheng, died.
translations.idiomatic: On maoyin of the fifth month Grand Commandant, Duke Yi of Rencheng, died.

sentences.zh: 行軍總管李晃破突厥於摩那渡口。

translations.literal: Campaign General Li Huang defeated the Turks at Monakou.

translations.literal: On the day xinhai of the seventh month of autumn, Henan provinces suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the seventh autumn month Henan provinces suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，京師雨毛如馬尾，長者二尺餘，短者有六七寸。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, hair like horse tails rained in the capital; the long measured more than two chi, the short six or seven cun.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day hair like horse tails rained in the capital; the long measured more than two chi, the short six or seven cun.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯關內七州旱，蠲其賦稅。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao of the eighth month, seven provinces within the passes suffered drought; their taxes and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the eighth month seven provinces within the passes suffered drought; their taxes and levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 遣散騎常侍裴世豪使於陳。

translations.literal: Attendant Cavalier Pei Shihao was dispatched as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Cavalier Pei Shihao was sent as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上柱國、太師、申公李穆薨。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Pillar of State, Grand Preceptor, Duke Mu of Shen, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Pillar of State, Grand Preceptor, Duke Mu of Shen, died.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁卯，皇太子鎮洛陽。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the intercalary month, the crown prince garrisoned Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the intercalary month the crown prince garrisoned Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，晉王廣、秦王俊並來朝。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Prince Guang of Jin and Prince Jun of Qin both came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Prince Guang of Jin and Prince Jun of Qin both came to court.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上柱國郕公梁士彥、上柱國巳公宇文忻、柱國舒公劉昉謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Pillar of State Duke Liang Shiyan of Xing, Pillar of State Duke Yuwen Xin of Ji, and Pillar of State Duke Liu Fang of Shu plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Pillar of State Duke Liang Shiyan of Xing, Pillar of State Duke Yuwen Xin of Ji, and Pillar of State Duke Liu Fang of Shu plotted rebellion and were executed.

sentences.zh: 上柱國、許公宇文善有罪，除名。

translations.literal: Pillar of State, Duke Shan of Xu, Yuwen Shan, was guilty and his name was removed from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar of State, Duke Shan of Xu, Yuwen Shan, was guilty and his name was removed from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，帝素服御射殿，詔百寮射梁士彥三家資物。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi of the ninth month, the Emperor in plain robes entered the Archery Hall and ordered the hundred officials to shoot at the goods of the three households of Liang Shiyan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the ninth month the Emperor in plain robes entered the Archery Hall and ordered the hundred officials to shoot at the goods of the three households of Liang Shiyan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上柱國、宋安公元景山卒。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Pillar of State, Prince Yuan Jingshan of Song'an, died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Pillar of State, Prince Yuan Jingshan of Song'an, died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔振恤大象以來死事之家。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict ordered relief for the families of those who died in service since Daxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict ordered relief for the families of those who died in service since Daxiang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，以河北道行臺尚書令、并州總管、晉王廣為雍州牧，余官如故。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the tenth month of winter, Prince Guang of Jin, Director of the Branch Department of State Affairs of Hebei Circuit and Area Commander of Bing Province, was made Governor of Yong Province; his other offices remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the tenth winter month Prince Guang of Jin, Director of the Branch Department of State Affairs of Hebei Circuit and Area Commander of Bing Province, became Governor of Yong Province; his other offices remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 以兵部尚書楊尚希為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Director of the Ministry of War Yang Shangxi was made Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Ministry of War Yang Shangxi became Director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，置山南道行臺尚書省於襄州，以秦王俊為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Branch Department of State Affairs of Shannan Circuit was established at Xiang Province, with Prince Jun of Qin as Director.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Branch Department of State Affairs of Shannan Circuit was established at Xiang Province, with Prince Jun of Qin as Director.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸巳，祀太廟。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, on the day guisi, the ancestral temple was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, first month, on guisi day the ancestral temple was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 乙未，制諸州歲貢三人。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, a regulation ordered that each province annually recommend three men.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day a regulation ordered that each province annually recommend three men.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，祀朝日於東郊。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi of the second month, the morning sun was sacrificed to at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the second month the morning sun was sacrificed to at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 己巳，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, men of Chen came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day men of Chen came on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸醴泉宮。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, he traveled to Liquan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he traveled to Liquan Palace.

sentences.zh: 是月，發丁男十萬修築長城，二旬而罷。

translations.literal: That month, one hundred thousand corvée men were mobilized to repair the Great Wall; after twenty days the work ceased.
translations.idiomatic: That month one hundred thousand corvée men were mobilized to repair the Great Wall; after twenty days the work ceased.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，於揚州開山陽瀆，以通運漕。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu of the fourth month of summer, the Shanyang Canal was opened at Yang Province to enable transport by water.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the fourth summer month the Shanyang Canal was opened at Yang Province to enable transport by water.

sentences.zh: 突厥沙缽略可汗卒。

translations.literal: The Turkic Khan Shabolue died.
translations.idiomatic: The Turkic Khan Shabolue died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，頒青龍符於東方總管、刺史；

translations.literal: On the day guihai, azure dragon talismans were issued to area commanders and governors of the east;
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day azure dragon talismans were issued to area commanders and governors of the east;

sentences.zh: 西方以白武；

translations.literal: the west used white martial talismans;
translations.idiomatic: the west used white martial talismans;

sentences.zh: 南方以朱雀；

translations.literal: the south used vermilion bird talismans;
translations.idiomatic: the south used vermilion bird talismans;

sentences.zh: 北方以玄武。

translations.literal: the north used dark warrior talismans.
translations.idiomatic: the north used dark warrior talismans.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣兼散騎常侍楊周使於陳。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Acting Attendant Cavalier Yang Zhou was dispatched as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Acting Attendant Cavalier Yang Zhou was sent as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書蘇威為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Director of the Ministry of Revenue Su Wei was made Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Ministry of Revenue Su Wei became Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day yihai of the fifth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the first day of the fifth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 己卯，隕石於武安、滏陽間，十餘里。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, a meteorite fell between Wu'an and Fuyang, covering more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day a meteorite fell between Wu'an and Fuyang, covering more than ten li.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，衛王爽薨。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the seventh month of autumn, Prince Shuang of Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou of the seventh autumn month Prince Shuang of Wei died.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，梁主蕭琮來朝。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen of the eighth month, the Liang ruler Xiao Cong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the eighth month the Liang ruler Xiao Cong came to court.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，梁安平王蕭巖掠於其國以奔陳。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou of the ninth month, Prince Yan of Anping of Liang, Xiao Yan, plundered his own state and fled to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the ninth month Prince Yan of Anping of Liang, Xiao Yan, plundered his own state and fled to Chen.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廢梁國，曲赦江陵。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the Liang state was abolished and Jiangling was specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Liang state was abolished and Jiangling was specially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 以梁主蕭琮為柱國，封莒國公。

translations.literal: The Liang ruler Xiao Cong was made Pillar of State and enfeoffed Duke of Ju.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang ruler Xiao Cong was made Pillar of State and enfeoffed Duke of Ju.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，行幸同州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day gengshen, he traveled to Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on gengshen day, he traveled to Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 以先帝所居故，曲降囚徒。

translations.literal: Because it was where the late Emperor had dwelt, prisoners were specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Because it was where the late Emperor had dwelt, prisoners were specially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，幸蒲州。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, he traveled to Pu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day he traveled to Pu Province.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宴父老，上極歡，曰：「此間人物，衣服鮮麗，容止閑雅。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, he feasted the elders and was extremely joyful, saying, "The people here, their clothes bright and fresh, their bearing leisurely and elegant—
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day he feasted the elders and was extremely joyful, saying, "The people here, their clothes bright and fresh, their bearing leisurely and elegant—

sentences.zh: 良由仕宦之鄉，陶染成俗也。

translations.literal: this is truly because it is a land of office-holding, molded by custom through long exposure."
translations.idiomatic: this is truly because it is a land of office-holding, molded by custom through long exposure."

sentences.zh: 」十一月甲午，幸馮翊，祭故社。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the eleventh month, he traveled to Fenyang and sacrificed at the old altar of soil.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the eleventh month he traveled to Fenyang and sacrificed at the old altar of soil.

sentences.zh: 父老對詔失旨，上大怒，免其縣官而去。

translations.literal: The elders answered the edict improperly; the Emperor was greatly angered, dismissed the county officials, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: The elders answered the edict improperly; the Emperor was greatly angered, dismissed the county officials, and departed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，車駕至自馮翊。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the imperial carriage returned from Fenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the imperial carriage returned from Fenyang.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月乙亥，陳人來聘。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year, on the day yihai, men of Chen came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, first month, on yihai day men of Chen came on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，陳人寇硤州。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou of the second month, men of Chen raided Xia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the second month men of Chen raided Xia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，上柱國、隴西公李詢卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the third month, Pillar of State, Duke Xun of Longxi, Li Xun, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the third month Pillar of State, Duke Xun of Longxi, Li Xun, died.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣兼散騎常侍程尚賢使於陳。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Acting Attendant Cavalier Cheng Shangxian was dispatched as envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Acting Attendant Cavalier Cheng Shangxian was sent as envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔大舉伐陳。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, an edict ordered a great campaign against Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict ordered a great campaign against Chen.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁未，河北諸州饑，遣吏部尚書蘇威振恤之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the seventh month of autumn, Hebei provinces suffered famine; Director of the Ministry of Personnel Su Wei was dispatched to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei of the seventh autumn month Hebei provinces suffered famine; Director of the Ministry of Personnel Su Wei was sent to give relief.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，嘉州言龍見。

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the ninth month, Jia Province reported that a dragon appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the ninth month Jia Province reported that a dragon appeared.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，置淮南行臺省於壽春，以晉王廣為尚書令。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the tenth month of winter, the Branch Department of State Affairs of Huainan Circuit was established at Shouchun, with Prince Guang of Jin as Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the tenth winter month the Branch Department of State Affairs of Huainan Circuit was established at Shouchun, with Prince Guang of Jin as Director.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，陳人來聘，拘留不遣。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, men of Chen came on a friendly mission; they were detained and not sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day men of Chen came on a friendly mission; they were detained and not sent back.

sentences.zh: 甲子，有星孛於牽牛。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, a broom star appeared in Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day a broom star appeared in Ox.

sentences.zh: 享太廟，授律，令晉王廣、秦王俊、清河公楊素並為行軍元帥以伐陳。

translations.literal: The ancestral temple was sacrificed to and the campaign law was received; Prince Guang of Jin, Prince Jun of Qin, Duke Su of Qinghe Yang Su, and others were all made campaign supreme commanders to attack Chen.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temple was sacrificed to and the campaign law was received; Prince Guang of Jin, Prince Jun of Qin, Duke Su of Qinghe Yang Su, and others were all made campaign supreme commanders to attack Chen.

sentences.zh: 於是晉王出六合，秦王出襄陽，清河公楊素出信州，荊州刺史劉仁恩出江陵，宜陽公王世積出蘄春，新義公韓擒出廬江，襄邑公賀若弼出吳州，落叢公燕榮出東海，合總管九十。

translations.literal: Thereupon Prince Jin went out from Liuhe, Prince Qin from Xiangyang, Duke Su of Qinghe from Xin Province, Governor of Jing Province Liu Ren'en from Jiangling, Duke Shiji of Yiyang from Qichun, Duke Qin of Xinyi Han Qin from Lujiang, Duke Bi of Ruoyang He Ruo Bi from Wu Province, Duke Rong of Luocong Yan Rong from Donghai—in all ninety area commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Prince Jin went out from Liuhe, Prince Qin from Xiangyang, Duke Su of Qinghe from Xin Province, Governor of Jing Province Liu Ren'en from Jiangling, Duke Shiji of Yiyang from Qichun, Duke Qin of Xinyi Han Qin from Lujiang, Duke Bi of Ruoyang He Ruo Bi from Wu Province, and Duke Rong of Luocong Yan Rong from Donghai—in all ninety area commanders.

sentences.zh: 兵五十一萬八千，皆受晉王節度。

translations.literal: The troops numbered five hundred eighteen thousand; all obeyed Prince Jin's command.
translations.idiomatic: The troops numbered five hundred eighteen thousand; all obeyed Prince Jin's command.

sentences.zh: 東接滄海，西拒巴蜀，旌旃舟楫，橫亙數千里。

translations.literal: East connecting to the blue sea, west resisting Ba-Shu, banners and boats stretched across several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: East connecting to the blue sea, west resisting Ba-Shu, banners and boats stretched across several thousand li.

sentences.zh: 仍曲赦陳國。

translations.literal: Chen was still specially pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Chen was still specially pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，車駕餞師。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the eleventh month, the Emperor saw off the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the eleventh month the Emperor saw off the army.

sentences.zh: 詔購陳叔寶，位上柱國、萬戶公。

translations.literal: An edict offered a reward for Chen Shubao: the rank of Pillar of State and Duke with ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: An edict offered a reward for Chen Shubao: the rank of Pillar of State and Duke with ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，行幸定城，陳師誓眾。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, he traveled to Ding City; the Chen army swore its host.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day he traveled to Ding City; the Chen army swore its host.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸河東。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, he traveled to Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he traveled to Hedong.

sentences.zh: 十二月，車駕至自河東。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the imperial carriage returned from Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the imperial carriage returned from Hedong.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月癸酉，以尚書左僕射虞慶則為右衛大將軍。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, on the day youyu, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Yu Qingze was made General of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, first month, on youyu day Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Yu Qingze became General of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賀若弼敗陳師於蔣山，獲其將蕭摩訶；

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, He Ruo Bi defeated the Chen army at Jiang Mountain and captured their general Xiao Mohe;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day He Ruo Bi defeated the Chen army at Jiang Mountain and captured their general Xiao Mohe;

sentences.zh: 韓擒進師入建鄴，獲陳主叔寶，陳國平。

translations.literal: Han Qin advanced his army into Jiankang and captured the Chen ruler Shubao; the Chen state was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qin advanced his army into Jiankang and captured the Chen ruler Shubao; the Chen state was pacified.

sentences.zh: 合州四十，郡一百，縣四百，戶五十萬，口二百萬。

translations.literal: In all forty provinces, one hundred commanderies, four hundred districts, five hundred thousand households, and two million persons.
translations.idiomatic: In all forty provinces, one hundred commanderies, four hundred districts, five hundred thousand households, and two million persons.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，遣使持節巡撫之。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, envoys bearing staffs of authority were dispatched to tour and pacify the region.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day envoys bearing staffs of authority were sent to tour and pacify the region.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，廢淮南尚書省。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the second month, the Branch Department of State Affairs of Huainan was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the second month the Branch Department of State Affairs of Huainan was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙申，制五百家為鄉，正一人；

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, a regulation ordered that five hundred households made a district and one man was district head;
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day a regulation ordered that five hundred households made a district and one man was district head;

sentences.zh: 百家為裏，長一人。

translations.literal: one hundred households made a li and one man was li chief.
translations.idiomatic: one hundred households made a li and one man was li chief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，幸驪山，親勞旋師。

translations.literal: On the day jihai of the fourth month of summer, he traveled to Mount Li and personally welcomed the returning army.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the fourth summer month he traveled to Mount Li and personally welcomed the returning army.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，三軍凱入，獻俘於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the three armies entered in triumph and captives were presented at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the three armies entered in triumph and captives were presented at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 以晉王廣為太尉。

translations.literal: Prince Guang of Jin was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Guang of Jin was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝御廣陽門，宴將士，頒賜各有差。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the Emperor entered Guangyang Gate, feasted officers and soldiers, and distributed rewards in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Emperor entered Guangyang Gate, feasted officers and soldiers, and distributed rewards in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 以陳都官尚書孔範、散騎常侍王差、王儀、御史中丞沈觀等邪佞於其主，以致亡滅，皆投之邊裔。

translations.literal: Director of the Ministry of Justice of Chen Kong Fan, Attendant Cavalier Wang Cha, Wang Yi, and Censor-in-Chief Shen Guan and others, through flattery toward their ruler, brought about ruin; all were sent to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Ministry of Justice of Chen Kong Fan, Attendant Cavalier Wang Cha, Wang Yi, and Censor-in-Chief Shen Guan and others, through flattery toward their ruler, brought about ruin; all were sent to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 陳人普給復十年。

translations.literal: The people of Chen were generally granted ten years' exemption from tax and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Chen were generally granted ten years' exemption from tax and corvée.

sentences.zh: 軍人畢世免徭役。

translations.literal: Soldiers were exempt from corvée for life.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers were exempt from corvée for life.

sentences.zh: 擢陳之文武眾才而用之。

translations.literal: Talented civil and military men of Chen were selected and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Talented civil and military men of Chen were selected and employed.

sentences.zh: 宮奴數千，可歸者歸之，其餘盡以分賜將士及王公貴臣。

translations.literal: Several thousand palace slaves who could return home were sent back; the rest were all distributed to officers and soldiers and to kings, dukes, and noble ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand palace slaves who could return home were sent back; the rest were all distributed to officers and soldiers and to kings, dukes, and noble ministers.

sentences.zh: 其資物，皆於五垛賜王公以下大射。

translations.literal: Their goods were all distributed at Wuduo to kings, dukes, and below for a great archery contest.
translations.idiomatic: Their goods were all distributed at Wuduo to kings, dukes, and below for a great archery contest.

sentences.zh: 毀所得秦漢三大鐘，越二大鼓。

translations.literal: The three great bells and two great drums obtained from Qin and Han were destroyed.

translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Heaven made a sound like pouring water, from south to north.
