sentences.zh: 夏五月癸卯，詔曰：「六月十三日是朕生日，其日令海內為武元皇帝、元明皇后斷屠。

translations.literal: On the day guimao of the fifth month of summer, an edict said, "The thirteenth day of the sixth month is my birthday; on that day let the realm abstain from slaughter for Emperor Wuyuan and Empress Yuanming."
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the fifth summer month an edict said, "The thirteenth day of the sixth month is my birthday; on that day let the realm abstain from slaughter for Emperor Wuyuan and Empress Yuanming."

sentences.zh: 」六月甲午，詔曰：《禮》云：親以期斷。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the sixth month, an edict said: The Rites say: mourning ends at the end of the year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the sixth month an edict said: The Rites say: mourning ends at the end of the year.

sentences.zh: 蓋以四時之變易，萬物之更始，故聖人象之。

translations.literal: This is because the four seasons change and the ten thousand things begin anew; therefore the sages took them as models.
translations.idiomatic: This is because the four seasons change and the ten thousand things begin anew; therefore the sages took them as models.

sentences.zh: 其有三年，加隆爾也。

translations.literal: For three years additional honor is added.
translations.idiomatic: For three years additional honor is added.

sentences.zh: 但家無二尊，母為厭降，是以父在喪母，還服於期者，服之正也。

translations.literal: But a household has no two supreme authorities; a mother receives reduced mourning because the father is alive; therefore when the father is alive and one mourns the mother, one returns to one-year mourning—this is the correct garment.
translations.idiomatic: But a household has no two supreme authorities; a mother receives reduced mourning because the father is alive; therefore when the father is alive and one mourns the mother, one returns to one-year mourning—this is the correct garment.

sentences.zh: 豈容期內而更小祥！

translations.literal: How can one perform lesser mourning within the one-year period!
translations.idiomatic: How can one perform lesser mourning within the one-year period!

sentences.zh: 然三年之喪而有小祥者，《禮》云：「期祭，禮也；

translations.literal: Yet for three-year mourning there is lesser mourning; the Rites say: "End-of-year sacrifice is ritual;
translations.idiomatic: Yet for three-year mourning there is lesser mourning; the Rites say: "End-of-year sacrifice is ritual;

sentences.zh: 期而除喪，道也。

translations.literal: ending mourning at the year mark is the Way.
translations.idiomatic: ending mourning at the year mark is the Way.

sentences.zh: 」以是之故，雖未再期，而天地一變，不可不祭，不可不除。

translations.literal: For this reason, though the second year has not yet come, when Heaven and earth change once, sacrifice cannot be omitted and mourning cannot be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason, though the second year has not yet come, when Heaven and earth change once, sacrifice cannot be omitted and mourning cannot be omitted.

sentences.zh: 故有練焉，以存喪祭之本。

translations.literal: Therefore there is the practice of refined mourning, to preserve the root of mourning sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore there is the practice of refined mourning, to preserve the root of mourning sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 然期喪有練，於理未安。

translations.literal: Yet one-year mourning with refined mourning is not secure in reason.
translations.idiomatic: Yet one-year mourning with refined mourning is not secure in reason.

sentences.zh: 雖云十一月而練，乃無所法象，非期非時，豈可除祭？

translations.literal: Though it says refined mourning in the eleventh month, there is no corresponding model; it is neither the year mark nor the proper season—how can sacrifice and mourning be removed?
translations.idiomatic: Though it says refined mourning in the eleventh month, there is no corresponding model; it is neither the year mark nor the proper season—how can sacrifice and mourning be removed?

sentences.zh: 而儒者徒擬三年之喪，立練禫之節，可謂茍存其變，而失其本；

translations.literal: Confucians merely modeled three-year mourning and established the stages of refined and burial mourning—this may be said to preserve the change but lose the root;
translations.idiomatic: Confucians merely modeled three-year mourning and established the stages of refined and burial mourning—this may be said to preserve the change but lose the root;

sentences.zh: 欲漸於奪，乃薄於喪。

translations.literal: wishing to advance toward reduction, they in fact make mourning thin.
translations.idiomatic: wishing to advance toward reduction, they in fact make mourning thin.

sentences.zh: 致使子則冠練去绖，黃裏縓緣；

translations.literal: Thus the son then wears refined cap and removes the hemp band, with yellow lining and hem;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the son then wears refined cap and removes the hemp band, with yellow lining and hem;

sentences.zh: 绖則布葛在躬，粗服未改。

translations.literal: the band then has hemp and ramie on the body, coarse garment unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: the band then has hemp and ramie on the body, coarse garment unchanged.

sentences.zh: 豈非绖哀尚存，子情已奪；

translations.literal: Is this not the hemp sorrow still present while the son's feeling is already taken away;
translations.idiomatic: Is this not the hemp sorrow still present while the son's feeling is already taken away;

sentences.zh: 親疏失倫，輕重顛倒。

translations.literal: near and distant lose order, light and heavy are reversed.
translations.idiomatic: near and distant lose order, light and heavy are reversed.

sentences.zh: 乃不順人情，豈聖人之意也？

translations.literal: This does not follow human feeling—can it be the intent of the sages?
translations.idiomatic: This does not follow human feeling—can it be the intent of the sages?

sentences.zh: 故非先聖之禮，廢於人邪！

translations.literal: Therefore rites that are not those of former sages are abandoned among the people!
translations.idiomatic: Therefore rites that are not those of former sages are abandoned among the people!

sentences.zh: 三年之喪，尚有不行之者；

translations.literal: For three-year mourning, there are those who do not practice it;
translations.idiomatic: For three-year mourning, there are those who do not practice it;

sentences.zh: 至於祥練之節，安能不墜者乎！

translations.literal: as for the stages of auspicious and refined mourning, how can they not fall away!
translations.idiomatic: as for the stages of auspicious and refined mourning, how can they not fall away!

sentences.zh: 《禮》云：父母之喪，無貴賤一也。

translations.literal: The Rites say: In mourning for parents, there is no distinction of noble and base.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites say: In mourning for parents, there is no distinction of noble and base.

sentences.zh: 而大夫士之喪父母，乃貴賤異服。

translations.literal: Yet great officers and gentlemen in mourning for parents wear garments differing by noble and base.
translations.idiomatic: Yet great officers and gentlemen in mourning for parents wear garments differing by noble and base.

sentences.zh: 然則禮壞樂崩，由來漸矣。

translations.literal: Thus ritual is broken and music collapsed—this has come about gradually.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ritual is broken and music collapsed—this has come about gradually.

sentences.zh: 所以晏平仲之斬粗缞，其老謂之非禮，滕文公之服三2年，其臣咸所不欲。

translations.literal: Therefore when Yan Pingzhong wore coarse hemp, the elders called it unritual; when Duke Wen of Teng observed three-year mourning, his ministers all disapproved.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when Yan Pingzhong wore coarse hemp, the elders called it unritual; when Duke Wen of Teng observed three-year mourning, his ministers all disapproved.

sentences.zh: 蓋由王道既衰，諸侯異政，將逾越於法度，惡禮制之害己。

translations.literal: This is because the royal Way had already declined and the feudal lords had differing policies; wishing to transgress law and measure, they hated ritual systems that harmed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: This is because the royal Way had already declined and the feudal lords had differing policies; wishing to transgress law and measure, they hated ritual systems that harmed themselves.

sentences.zh: 乃滅去篇籍，自制其宜。

translations.literal: They then destroyed written records and made their own convenience.
translations.idiomatic: They then destroyed written records and made their own convenience.

sentences.zh: 遂至骨肉之恩，輕重從俗，無易之道，降殺任情。

translations.literal: Thus even the affection between bone and flesh followed custom in light and heavy; there was no constant Way, and reduction followed feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Thus even the affection between bone and flesh followed custom in light and heavy; there was no constant Way, and reduction followed feeling.

sentences.zh: 夫禮不從天降，不從地出，乃人心而已者，謂情緣於恩也。

translations.literal: Ritual does not descend from Heaven, nor does it emerge from Earth—it is only the human heart; this is called feeling arising from grace.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual does not descend from Heaven, nor does it emerge from Earth—it is only the human heart; this is called feeling arising from grace.

sentences.zh: 故恩厚者其禮隆，情輕者其禮殺。

translations.literal: Therefore where grace is thick, ritual is lofty; where feeling is light, ritual is reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore where grace is thick, ritual is lofty; where feeling is light, ritual is reduced.

sentences.zh: 聖人以是稱情立文，別親疏貴賤之節。

translations.literal: The sages thereby weighed feeling and established text, distinguishing degrees of near and distant, noble and base.
translations.idiomatic: The sages thereby weighed feeling and established text, distinguishing degrees of near and distant, noble and base.

sentences.zh: 自臣子道消，上下失序，莫大之恩，逐情而薄；

translations.literal: Since the Way of subject and lord declined and upper and lower lost order, the greatest grace followed feeling and became thin;
translations.idiomatic: Since the Way of subject and lord declined and upper and lower lost order, the greatest grace followed feeling and became thin;

sentences.zh: 莫重之化，與時而殺。

translations.literal: the heaviest transformation followed the times and was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: the heaviest transformation followed the times and was reduced.

sentences.zh: 此乃服不稱喪，容不稱服，非所謂聖人緣恩表情制禮之義也。

translations.literal: This is garment not matching mourning and appearance not matching garment—not the meaning of the sages who follow grace, express feeling, and establish ritual through system.
translations.idiomatic: This is garment not matching mourning and appearance not matching garment—not the meaning of the sages who follow grace, express feeling, and establish ritual through system.

sentences.zh: 然喪與其易也，寧在於戚，則禮之本也。

translations.literal: Yet mourning prefers ease, but it is better to be sorrowful—this is the root of ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Yet mourning prefers ease, but it is better to be sorrowful—this is the root of ritual.

sentences.zh: 禮有其餘，未若於哀，則情之實也。

translations.literal: Ritual has its surplus, but not as much as sorrow—this is the reality of feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual has its surplus, but not as much as sorrow—this is the reality of feeling.

sentences.zh: 今十一月而練者，非禮之本，非情之實。

translations.literal: Now refined mourning in the eleventh month is not the root of ritual, not the reality of feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Now refined mourning in the eleventh month is not the root of ritual, not the reality of feeling.

sentences.zh: 由是言之，父在喪母，不宜有練。

translations.literal: From this speaking, when the father is alive and one mourns the mother, refined mourning is not appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: From this speaking, when the father is alive and one mourns the mother, refined mourning is not appropriate.

sentences.zh: 但依《禮》十三月而祥，中月而禫，庶以合聖人之意，達人子之心。

translations.literal: But according to the Rites, auspicious mourning in the thirteenth month and burial mourning in the middle month—this may accord with the intent of the sages and fulfill the heart of the son.
translations.idiomatic: But according to the Rites, auspicious mourning in the thirteenth month and burial mourning in the middle month—this may accord with the intent of the sages and fulfill the heart of the son.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，詔州縣搜揚賢哲，皆取明知古今，通識安危，究政教之本，達禮樂之源。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the seventh month of autumn, an edict ordered districts and counties to search out and promote worthy and wise men, all to be clearly knowledgeable in antiquity and the present, thoroughly understanding safety and danger, investigating the roots of government and teaching, and penetrating the sources of ritual and music.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered districts and counties to search out and promote worthy and wise men, all to be clearly knowledgeable in antiquity and the present, thoroughly understanding safety and danger, investigating the roots of government and teaching, and penetrating the sources of ritual and music.

sentences.zh: 不限多少，不得不舉。

translations.literal: No matter how many, none may fail to be recommended.
translations.idiomatic: No matter how many, none may fail to be recommended.

sentences.zh: 徵召將送，必須以禮。

translations.literal: When summoned and sent, ritual must be observed.
translations.idiomatic: When summoned and sent, ritual must be observed.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，上柱國、檢校幽州總管、落叢公燕榮以罪伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day renshen of the eighth month, Pillar of State, Inspecting Area Commander of You Province, Duke Rong of Luocong, Yan Rong, was executed for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the eighth month Pillar of State, Inspecting Area Commander of You Province, Duke Rong of Luocong, Yan Rong, was executed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，置常平官。

translations.literal: On the day renxu of the ninth month, Ever-Normal officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the ninth month Ever-Normal officials were established.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以營州總管韋沖為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Area Commander of Ying Province Wei Chong was made Director of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Area Commander of Ying Province Wei Chong became Director of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，河南諸州水，遣納言楊達振恤之。

translations.literal: On the day youyu of the twelfth month, Henan provinces suffered flooding; Censor-in-Chief Yang Da was dispatched to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: On youyu of the twelfth month Henan provinces suffered flooding; Censor-in-Chief Yang Da was sent to give relief.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙辰，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, on the day bingchen, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month, on bingchen day a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸仁壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, he traveled to Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day he traveled to Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，上不豫。

translations.literal: On the day yimao of the fourth month of summer, the Emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the fourth summer month the Emperor was unwell.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu of the sixth month, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the sixth month a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 有星入月中，數日而退，長人見於雁門。

translations.literal: A star entered the moon, withdrew after several days, and a giant was seen at Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: A star entered the moon, withdrew after several days, and a giant was seen at Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，日青無光，八日乃復。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the seventh month of autumn, the sun was green and without light; after eight days it returned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the seventh autumn month the sun was green and without light; after eight days it returned.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，帝疾甚，臥於仁壽宮，與百僚辭訣，上握手歔欷。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Emperor's illness was severe; he lay at Renshou Palace and took leave of the hundred officials; the Emperor held hands and sighed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Emperor's illness was severe; he lay at Renshou Palace and took leave of the hundred officials; the Emperor held hands and sighed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，崩於大寶殿，時年六十四。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he died at Dabao Hall at the age of sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day he died at Dabao Hall at the age of sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：嗟乎！

translations.literal: An edict said: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: Alas!

sentences.zh: 自昔晉室播遷，天下喪亂，四海不一。

translations.literal: From of old the Jin house was driven abroad; the realm fell into disorder and was not unified.
translations.idiomatic: From of old the Jin house was driven abroad; the realm fell into disorder and was not unified.

sentences.zh: 以至周、齊，戰爭相尋，年將三百。

translations.literal: Down to Zhou and Qi, war followed war for nearly three hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: Down to Zhou and Qi, war followed war for nearly three hundred years.

sentences.zh: 故割疆土者非一所，稱帝王者非一人。

translations.literal: Thus those who carved out territory were not in one place, and those who called themselves emperors were not one man.
translations.idiomatic: Thus those who carved out territory were not in one place, and those who called themselves emperors were not one man.

sentences.zh: 書軌不同，生靈塗炭。

translations.literal: Writing and cart-tracks differed; living things were smeared with charcoal.
translations.idiomatic: Writing and cart-tracks differed; living things were smeared with charcoal.

sentences.zh: 上天降監，受命於朕，用登大位，豈關人力？

translations.literal: Heaven sent down oversight and I received the mandate; by this I ascended the great throne—how could it depend on human power?
translations.idiomatic: Heaven sent down oversight and I received the mandate; by this I ascended the great throne—how could it depend on human power?

sentences.zh: 故得撥亂反正，偃武修文；

translations.literal: Thus I was able to set right what was disordered, sheathe weapons and cultivate culture;
translations.idiomatic: Thus I was able to set right what was disordered, sheathe weapons and cultivate culture;

sentences.zh: 天下大同，聲教遠被，此又是天意欲寧區夏。

translations.literal: the realm was greatly unified and sound and teaching spread far—this again was Heaven's intent to bring peace to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: the realm was greatly unified and sound and teaching spread far—this again was Heaven's intent to bring peace to the realm.

sentences.zh: 所以昧旦臨朝，不敢逸豫；；

translations.literal: Therefore from dawn I attended court and dared not take ease;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore from dawn I attended court and dared not take ease;

sentences.zh: 一日萬機，留心親覽；

translations.literal: ten thousand affairs daily, I attended to them personally;
translations.idiomatic: ten thousand affairs daily, I attended to them personally;

sentences.zh: 晦明寒暑，不憚劬勞；

translations.literal: from dark to light, from cold to heat, I did not fear toil;
translations.idiomatic: from dark to light, from cold to heat, I did not fear toil;

sentences.zh: 匪曰朕躬，蓋為百姓故也。

translations.literal: this was not for my own person, but for the black-headed people.
translations.idiomatic: this was not for my own person, but for the black-headed people.

sentences.zh: 王公卿士，每日闕庭，刺史以下，歲時朝集。

translations.literal: Kings, dukes, and ministers daily attended court; governors and below came to court each year.
translations.idiomatic: Kings, dukes, and ministers daily attended court; governors and below came to court each year.

sentences.zh: 何嘗不罄竭心府，誡敕殷勤。

translations.literal: When did I not exhaust heart and mind and admonish with earnest care?
translations.idiomatic: When did I not exhaust heart and mind and admonish with earnest care?

sentences.zh: 義乃君臣，情兼父子，庶藉百寮之智，萬國歡心。

translations.literal: Righteousness joined lord and minister; feeling joined father and son; I wished to borrow the wisdom of the hundred offices and the heart of the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Righteousness joined lord and minister; feeling joined father and son; I wished to borrow the wisdom of the hundred offices and the heart of the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 欲令率土之人，永得安樂。

translations.literal: I wished to make all within the realm forever secure and happy.
translations.idiomatic: I wished to make all within the realm forever secure and happy.

sentences.zh: 不謂遘疾彌留，至於大漸。

translations.literal: I did not expect to encounter lingering illness leading to the great decline.
translations.idiomatic: I did not expect to encounter lingering illness leading to the great decline.

sentences.zh: 此乃人生常分，何足言及。

translations.literal: This is the constant portion of human life—what is there to speak of?
translations.idiomatic: This is the constant portion of human life—what is there to speak of?

sentences.zh: 但四海百姓，衣食不豐；

translations.literal: Yet the black-headed people of the four seas—clothing and food are not abundant;
translations.idiomatic: Yet the black-headed people of the four seas—clothing and food are not abundant;

sentences.zh: 教化政刑，猶未盡洽。

translations.literal: transformation, government, punishment, and law are still not fully harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: transformation, government, punishment, and law are still not fully harmonized.

sentences.zh: 興言念此，唯以留恨。

translations.literal: Speaking of this moves me to regret alone.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking of this moves me to regret alone.

sentences.zh: 朕今逾六十，不復稱夭；

translations.literal: I now exceed sixty and can no longer be called early death;
translations.idiomatic: I now exceed sixty and can no longer be called early death;

sentences.zh: 但筋力精神，一時勞竭。

translations.literal: but sinew, strength, and spirit were exhausted at one stroke.
translations.idiomatic: but sinew, strength, and spirit were exhausted at one stroke.

sentences.zh: 如此之事，本非為身，止欲安養百姓，所以致此。

translations.literal: Matters like this were originally not for myself; I only wished to nurture and settle the black-headed people, and so reached this.
translations.idiomatic: Matters like this were originally not for myself; I only wished to nurture and settle the black-headed people, and so reached this.

sentences.zh: 人生子孫，誰不念愛？

translations.literal: Who among men does not cherish his sons and grandsons?
translations.idiomatic: Who among men does not cherish his sons and grandsons?

sentences.zh: 既為天下，事須割情。

translations.literal: Since it is for the realm, affairs require cutting off feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Since it is for the realm, affairs require cutting off feeling.

sentences.zh: 勇及秀等，並懷悖惡；

translations.literal: Yong, Xiu, and others all harbored perverse wickedness;
translations.idiomatic: Yong, Xiu, and others all harbored perverse wickedness;

sentences.zh: 既無臣子之心，所以黜廢。

translations.literal: having no heart of subject and son, they were therefore deposed.
translations.idiomatic: having no heart of subject and son, they were therefore deposed.

sentences.zh: 古人有云：「知臣莫若君，知子莫若父。

translations.literal: The ancients said, "No one knows a minister like his lord; no one knows a son like his father."
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said, "No one knows a minister like his lord; no one knows a son like his father."

sentences.zh: 」令勇、秀得志，共理家國，亦當戮辱遍於公卿，酷毒流於人庶。

translations.literal: If Yong and Xiu had gotten their wish and jointly governed the house and state, disgrace would likewise have spread among the dukes and humiliation and cruelty would have flowed among the people.
translations.idiomatic: If Yong and Xiu had gotten their wish and jointly governed the house and state, disgrace would likewise have spread among the dukes and humiliation and cruelty would have flowed among the people.

sentences.zh: 今惡子孫已為百姓黜屏，好子孫足堪負荷大業。

translations.literal: Now the wicked sons and grandsons have been deposed and removed for the people; the good sons and grandsons are fully able to bear the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Now the wicked sons and grandsons have been deposed and removed for the people; the good sons and grandsons are fully able to bear the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 此雖朕家事，理不容隱，前對文武侍衛，具已論述。

translations.literal: Though this is my household affair, reason does not permit concealment; before the civil and military attendants I have fully stated it.
translations.idiomatic: Though this is my household affair, reason does not permit concealment; before the civil and military attendants I have fully stated it.

sentences.zh: 皇太子廣，地居上嗣，仁孝著聞。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Guang occupies the position of eldest heir; his benevolence and filial piety are renowned.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Guang occupies the position of eldest heir; his benevolence and filial piety are renowned.

sentences.zh: 以其行業，堪成朕志。

translations.literal: By his conduct and achievement he can fulfill my intent.
translations.idiomatic: By his conduct and achievement he can fulfill my intent.

sentences.zh: 但念內外群官，同心戮力，以此共安天下。

translations.literal: Only consider that inner and outer officials with one heart and combined strength may thereby together settle the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Only consider that inner and outer officials with one heart and combined strength may thereby together settle the realm.

sentences.zh: 朕雖瞑目，何所復恨？

translations.literal: Though I close my eyes, what further regret remains?
translations.idiomatic: Though I close my eyes, what further regret remains?

sentences.zh: 國家大事，不可限以常禮；

translations.literal: State great affairs cannot be limited by ordinary ritual;
translations.idiomatic: State great affairs cannot be limited by ordinary ritual;

sentences.zh: 既葬公除，行之自昔，今宜遵用，不勞改定。

translations.literal: after burial public mourning is ended—this has been practiced from of old; now it should be followed and need not be changed.
translations.idiomatic: after burial public mourning is ended—this has been practiced from of old; now it should be followed and need not be changed.

sentences.zh: 凶禮所須，才令周事，務從節儉，不得勞人。

translations.literal: What mourning rites require should suffice for completion; effort should follow frugality and must not weary the people.
translations.idiomatic: What mourning rites require should suffice for completion; effort should follow frugality and must not weary the people.

sentences.zh: 諸州總管、刺史以下，宜率其職，不須奔赴。

translations.literal: Area commanders, governors, and below should each perform their duties and need not come to mourn.
translations.idiomatic: Area commanders, governors, and below should each perform their duties and need not come to mourn.

sentences.zh: 自古哲王，因人作法，前帝後帝，沿革隨時。

translations.literal: From of old wise emperors made law through the people; former emperors and later emperors revised according to the times.
translations.idiomatic: From of old wise emperors made law through the people; former emperors and later emperors revised according to the times.

sentences.zh: 律令格式有不便於事者，宜依前修改，務當政要。

translations.literal: Where laws, ordinances, forms, and patterns are inconvenient to affairs, they should be revised as before according to what is essential to government.
translations.idiomatic: Where laws, ordinances, forms, and patterns are inconvenient to affairs, they should be revised as before according to what is essential to government.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 敬之哉，無墜朕命。

translations.literal: Revere it! Do not fall from my command.
translations.idiomatic: Revere it! Do not fall from my command.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，發喪。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, mourning was begun.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day mourning was begun.

sentences.zh: 河間楊柳四株，無故黃落，既而花葉復生。

translations.literal: Four willow trees at Hejian turned yellow and fell without cause, then flowers and leaves grew again.
translations.idiomatic: Four willow trees at Hejian turned yellow and fell without cause, then flowers and leaves grew again.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，梓宮至自仁壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the eighth month, the coffin arrived from Renshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the eighth month the coffin arrived from Renshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，殯於大興前殿。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the coffin was placed in the front hall of Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the coffin was placed in the front hall of Daxing.

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯，葬於太陵，同墳而異穴。

translations.literal: On the day yimao of the tenth month, he was buried at Tailing, same mound but separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the tenth month he was buried at Tailing, same mound but separate chambers.

sentences.zh: 士庶赴葬者，皆聽入視陵內。

translations.literal: Commoners and officials who came to the funeral were all allowed to enter and view the tomb interior.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners and officials who came to the funeral were all allowed to enter and view the tomb interior.

sentences.zh: 帝性嚴重有威容，外質木而內明敏，有大略。

translations.literal: The Emperor's nature was stern and grave, with a dignified bearing; outwardly plain and wooden yet inwardly bright and keen, he had great strategic vision.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's nature was stern and grave, with a dignified bearing; outwardly plain and wooden yet inwardly bright and keen, he had great strategic vision.

sentences.zh: 初得政之始，群情不附。

translations.literal: At the beginning of receiving government, popular sentiment was not attached.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of receiving government, popular sentiment was not attached.

sentences.zh: 諸子幼弱，內有六王之謀，外致三方之亂，握強兵、居重鎮者，皆周之舊臣。

translations.literal: His sons were young and weak; within there was the plot of the six kings, without there was disorder from three directions; those who held strong armies and occupied weighty garrisons were all old ministers of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were young and weak; within there was the plot of the six kings, without there was disorder from three directions; those who held strong armies and occupied weighty garrisons were all old ministers of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 上推以赤心，各盡其用。

translations.literal: The Emperor treated them with an open heart and each was fully employed.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor treated them with an open heart and each was fully employed.

sentences.zh: 不逾期月，克定三邊；

translations.literal: Within no more than a month he settled the three frontiers;
translations.idiomatic: Within no more than a month he settled the three frontiers;

sentences.zh: 未及十年，平一四海。

translations.literal: before ten years had passed he pacified the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: before ten years had passed he pacified the four seas.

sentences.zh: 薄賦斂，輕刑罰；

translations.literal: Taxes and levies were light and punishments mild;
translations.idiomatic: Taxes and levies were light and punishments mild;

sentences.zh: 內修制度，外撫戎夷。

translations.literal: internally he refined institutions and externally he soothed the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: internally he refined institutions and externally he soothed the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 每旦聽朝，日仄忘倦。

translations.literal: Each dawn he heard court until the sun slanted, forgetting weariness.
translations.idiomatic: Each dawn he heard court until the sun slanted, forgetting weariness.

sentences.zh: 居處服玩，務存節儉，令行禁止，上下化之。

translations.literal: In dwelling, dress, and playthings he strove to preserve frugality; orders issued were forbidden and upper and lower were transformed.
translations.idiomatic: In dwelling, dress, and playthings he strove to preserve frugality; orders issued were forbidden and upper and lower were transformed.

sentences.zh: 開皇、仁壽之間，丈夫不衣綾綺而無金玉之飾。

translations.literal: Between Kaihuang and Renshou, men did not wear silk gauze and had no gold or jade ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: Between Kaihuang and Renshou, men did not wear silk gauze and had no gold or jade ornaments.

sentences.zh: 常服率多布帛，裝帶不過以銅鐵骨角而已。

translations.literal: Ordinary dress was mostly cloth and silk; belts and fittings were only copper, iron, bone, and horn.
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary dress was mostly cloth and silk; belts and fittings were only copper, iron, bone, and horn.

sentences.zh: 雖嗇於財，至於賞賜有功，亦無所愛惜。

translations.literal: Though sparing with wealth, when rewarding merit he also showed no stinginess.
translations.idiomatic: Though sparing with wealth, when rewarding merit he also showed no stinginess.

sentences.zh: 每乘輿四出，路逢上表者，駐馬親自臨問。

translations.literal: Whenever the carriage went out on the four roads, if he encountered someone submitting a memorial, he halted the horses and personally went to inquire.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the carriage went out on the four roads, if he encountered someone submitting a memorial, he halted the horses and personally went to inquire.

sentences.zh: 或潛遣行人，采聽風俗；

translations.literal: Sometimes he secretly sent travelers to listen to local customs;
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes he secretly sent travelers to listen to local customs;

sentences.zh: 吏政得失，人間疾苦，無不留意。

translations.literal: the gains and losses of officials' government and the people's hardships—none escaped his notice.
translations.idiomatic: the gains and losses of officials' government and the people's hardships—none escaped his notice.

sentences.zh: 嘗遇關中饑，遣左右視百姓所食。

translations.literal: Once when Guanzhong suffered famine, he sent attendants to observe what the people ate.
translations.idiomatic: Once when Guanzhong suffered famine, he sent attendants to observe what the people ate.

sentences.zh: 有得豆屑雜糠而奏之者，上流涕以示群臣；

translations.literal: When one reported bean husks mixed with chaff, the Emperor wept and showed the ministers;
translations.idiomatic: When one reported bean husks mixed with chaff, the Emperor wept and showed the ministers;

sentences.zh: 深自咎責，為之損膳而不禦酒肉者，殆將一期。

translations.literal: deeply blaming himself, he reduced his meals and for nearly a full year did not take wine or meat.
translations.idiomatic: deeply blaming himself, he reduced his meals and for nearly a full year did not take wine or meat.

sentences.zh: 及東拜太山，關中戶口就食洛陽者，道路相屬。

translations.literal: When he traveled east to worship at Mount Tai, households from Guanzhong going to Luoyang for food lined the road.
translations.idiomatic: When he traveled east to worship at Mount Tai, households from Guanzhong going to Luoyang for food lined the road.

sentences.zh: 帝敕斥候，不得輒有驅逼，男女參廁於仗衛之間。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered scouts not to drive them by force; men and women shared latrines among the guards.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered scouts not to drive them by force; men and women shared latrines among the guards.

sentences.zh: 遇逢扶老攜幼者，輒引馬避之，慰勉而去。

translations.literal: When he encountered those supporting the old and leading the young, he drew aside his horse to avoid them and comforted them as he passed.
translations.idiomatic: When he encountered those supporting the old and leading the young, he drew aside his horse to avoid them and comforted them as he passed.

sentences.zh: 至艱險之處，見負擔者，遽令左右扶助之。

translations.literal: At dangerous places, when he saw burden-bearers, he immediately ordered attendants to assist them.
translations.idiomatic: At dangerous places, when he saw burden-bearers, he immediately ordered attendants to assist them.

sentences.zh: 其有將士戰歿，必加優賞，仍令使者，就家勞問。

translations.literal: When officers and soldiers died in battle, he always added generous rewards and still sent envoys to their homes to express sympathy.
translations.idiomatic: When officers and soldiers died in battle, he always added generous rewards and still sent envoys to their homes to express sympathy.

sentences.zh: 自強不息，朝夕孜孜。

translations.literal: Unceasingly striving, from morning to evening he was diligent.
translations.idiomatic: Unceasingly striving, from morning to evening he was diligent.

sentences.zh: 人庶殷繁，帑藏充實。

translations.literal: The people were numerous and prosperous; the treasury was full.
translations.idiomatic: The people were numerous and prosperous; the treasury was full.

sentences.zh: 雖未能臻於至道，亦足稱近代之良主。

translations.literal: Though he could not reach the utmost Way, he was enough to be called a good ruler of recent times.
translations.idiomatic: Though he could not reach the utmost Way, he was enough to be called a good ruler of recent times.

sentences.zh: 然雅性沈猜，素無學術，好為小數。

translations.literal: Yet by nature he was deep and suspicious, utterly without learning, and fond of petty techniques.
translations.idiomatic: Yet by nature he was deep and suspicious, utterly without learning, and fond of petty techniques.

sentences.zh: 言神燭聖杖，堪能療病。

translations.literal: He said divine candles and sacred staffs could cure illness.
translations.idiomatic: He said divine candles and sacred staffs could cure illness.

sentences.zh: 又信王劭解石文以為己瑞焉。

translations.literal: He also believed Wang Shao's interpretation of inscribed stone as his own omen.
translations.idiomatic: He also believed Wang Shao's interpretation of inscribed stone as his own omen.

sentences.zh: 不達大體如是。

translations.literal: He did not comprehend the great pattern in this way.
translations.idiomatic: He did not comprehend the great pattern in this way.

sentences.zh: 故忠臣義士，莫得盡心竭辭。

translations.literal: Thus loyal ministers and righteous men could not fully devote heart and words.
translations.idiomatic: Thus loyal ministers and righteous men could not fully devote heart and words.

sentences.zh: 其草創元勛，及有功諸將，誅夷獲罪，罕有存者。

translations.literal: The founding meritorious officials and generals with achievement were executed and punished; few survived.
translations.idiomatic: The founding meritorious officials and generals with achievement were executed and punished; few survived.

sentences.zh: 又不悅詩書，楊素由之希旨，遂奏除學校。

translations.literal: He also disliked poetry and books; Yang Su accordingly pleased his intent and so memorialized the abolition of schools.
translations.idiomatic: He also disliked poetry and books; Yang Su accordingly pleased his intent and so memorialized the abolition of schools.

sentences.zh: 唯婦言是用，廢黜諸子。

translations.literal: He listened only to women's words and deposed his sons.
translations.idiomatic: He listened only to women's words and deposed his sons.

sentences.zh: 逮於暮年，持法尤峻，喜怒失常，果於殺戮。

translations.literal: Reaching his later years, he held the law especially stern; joy and anger lost proper measure and he was quick to kill.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching his later years, he held the law especially stern; joy and anger lost proper measure and he was quick to kill.

sentences.zh: 嘗令左右送西域朝貢使出關，其人所經之處，受牧宰小物，饋鸚鵡、麖皮、馬鞭之屬，聞而大怒。

translations.literal: Once he ordered attendants to escort Western Region tribute envoys out of the pass; wherever they passed they received small gifts from governors and magistrates—parrots, deer skin, horsewhips, and the like; hearing of it he was greatly angered.
translations.idiomatic: Once he ordered attendants to escort Western Region tribute envoys out of the pass; wherever they passed they received small gifts from governors and magistrates—parrots, deer skin, horsewhips, and the like; hearing of it he was greatly angered.

sentences.zh: 又詣武庫，見署中蕪穢不理，於是執武庫令及諸受遺者，出開遠門外，親自臨決，死者數十人。

translations.literal: He also went to the armory and saw the offices filthy and neglected; he then seized the armory director and all who received gifts, went outside Kaiyuan Gate, and personally supervised execution; several tens died.
translations.idiomatic: He also went to the armory and saw the offices filthy and neglected; he then seized the armory director and all who received gifts, went outside Kaiyuan Gate, and personally supervised execution; several tens died.

sentences.zh: 又往往潛令賂遺令史，府史受者必死，無所寬貸，議者以此少之。

translations.literal: He also often secretly ordered bribes to clerks; those who received them from prefectural and office clerks were certainly executed without pardon; critics therefore thought less of him for this.
translations.idiomatic: He also often secretly ordered bribes to clerks; those who received them from prefectural and office clerks were certainly executed without pardon; critics therefore thought less of him for this.

sentences.zh: 論曰：隋文帝樹基立本，積德累仁。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Emperor Wen of Sui planted foundation and established root, accumulating virtue and accumulating benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary says: Emperor Wen of Sui planted foundation and established root, accumulating virtue and accumulating benevolence.

sentences.zh: 徒以外戚之尊，受托孤之任，與能之議，未為所許。

translations.literal: He was only by the honor of maternal kin, entrusted with the charge of a minor heir; the deliberation on worthiness did not approve him.
translations.idiomatic: He was only by the honor of maternal kin, entrusted with the charge of a minor heir; the deliberation on worthiness did not approve him.

sentences.zh: 是以周室舊臣，咸懷憤惋。

translations.literal: Thus old ministers of the Zhou house all harbored indignation.
translations.idiomatic: Thus old ministers of the Zhou house all harbored indignation.

sentences.zh: 既而王謙固三蜀之阻，不逾期月；

translations.literal: Then Wang Qian held the obstacle of the three Shu; within no more than a month;
translations.idiomatic: Then Wang Qian held the obstacle of the three Shu; within no more than a month;

sentences.zh: 尉遲迥舉全齊之眾，一戰而亡。

translations.literal: Yuchi Jiong raised the full host of Qi; one battle and he perished.
translations.idiomatic: Yuchi Jiong raised the full host of Qi; one battle and he perished.

sentences.zh: 斯乃非止人謀，抑亦天之所贊。

translations.literal: This was not only human planning; it was also what Heaven supported.
translations.idiomatic: This was not only human planning; it was also what Heaven supported.

sentences.zh: 乘茲機運，遂遷周鼎。

translations.literal: Seizing this opportunity of the times, he then moved the Zhou cauldron.
translations.idiomatic: Seizing this opportunity of the times, he then moved the Zhou cauldron.

sentences.zh: 於時蠻夷猾夏，荊、揚未一，劬勞日仄，經營四方。

translations.literal: At that time barbarians were unruly and Xia unsettled; Jing and Yang were not yet unified; he toiled from dawn to dusk and managed the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: At that time barbarians were unruly and Xia unsettled; Jing and Yang were not yet unified; he toiled from dawn to dusk and managed the four directions.

sentences.zh: 樓船南邁，則金陵失險；

translations.literal: Tower ships marched south and Jinling lost its peril;
translations.idiomatic: Tower ships marched south and Jinling lost its peril;

sentences.zh: 驃騎北指，則單于款塞。

translations.literal: Agile cavalry pointed north and the Chanyu submitted at the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Agile cavalry pointed north and the Chanyu submitted at the frontier.

sentences.zh: 《職方》所載，並入疆理；

translations.literal: What the Director of Regions records all entered the boundaries of administration;
translations.idiomatic: What the Director of Regions records all entered the boundaries of administration;

sentences.zh: 《禹貢》所圖，咸受正朔。

translations.literal: What the Tribute of Yu maps all received the correct calendar.
translations.idiomatic: What the Tribute of Yu maps all received the correct calendar.

sentences.zh: 雖晉武之克平吳會，漢宣之推亡固存，比義論功，不能尚也。

translations.literal: Though Emperor Wu of Jin conquered Wu and Hui, and Emperor Xuan of Han pushed ruin and strengthened what remained—in comparing righteousness and discussing merit, they cannot be placed above.
translations.idiomatic: Though Emperor Wu of Jin conquered Wu and Hui, and Emperor Xuan of Han pushed ruin and strengthened what remained—in comparing righteousness and discussing merit, they cannot be placed above.

sentences.zh: 七德既敷，九歌已洽，尉候無警，遐邇肅清。

translations.literal: Once the seven virtues were spread and the nine songs harmonized, frontier guards were without alarm and far and near were solemnly pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Once the seven virtues were spread and the nine songs harmonized, frontier guards were without alarm and far and near were solemnly pacified.

sentences.zh: 於是躬節儉，平徭賦，倉廩實，法令行。

translations.literal: Then he personally practiced frugality, equalized corvée and taxes, filled granaries, and put laws into effect.
translations.idiomatic: Then he personally practiced frugality, equalized corvée and taxes, filled granaries, and put laws into effect.

sentences.zh: 君子咸樂其生，小人各安其業，強不陵弱，眾不暴寡；

translations.literal: Gentlemen all rejoiced in life; commoners each settled in their work; the strong did not bully the weak and the many did not oppress the few;
translations.idiomatic: Gentlemen all rejoiced in life; commoners each settled in their work; the strong did not bully the weak and the many did not oppress the few;

sentences.zh: 人物殷阜，朝野歡娛。

translations.literal: persons and things were abundant; court and countryside were joyful.
translations.idiomatic: persons and things were abundant; court and countryside were joyful.

sentences.zh: 自開皇二十年間，天下無事；

translations.literal: From the twentieth year of Kaihuang, the realm was without affairs;
translations.idiomatic: From the twentieth year of Kaihuang, the realm was without affairs;

sentences.zh: 區宇之內，晏如也。

translations.literal: within the four quarters all was tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: within the four quarters all was tranquil.

sentences.zh: 考之前王，足以參蹤盛烈。

translations.literal: Examining former kings, he was enough to compare in tracing grand achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Examining former kings, he was enough to compare in tracing grand achievement.

sentences.zh: 而素無術業，不能盡下。

translations.literal: Yet he was utterly without arts and learning and could not fully defer to those below.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was utterly without arts and learning and could not fully defer to those below.

sentences.zh: 無寬仁之度，有刻薄之資。

translations.literal: He had no measure of generous benevolence but the material of harshness.
translations.idiomatic: He had no measure of generous benevolence but the material of harshness.

sentences.zh: 暨乎暮年，此風愈扇。

translations.literal: Reaching his later years, this tendency grew ever stronger.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching his later years, this tendency grew ever stronger.

sentences.zh: 又雅好瑞符，暗於大道。

translations.literal: He also by nature loved auspicious omens and was dark to the great Way.
translations.idiomatic: He also by nature loved auspicious omens and was dark to the great Way.

sentences.zh: 建彼維城，權侔京室，皆同帝制，靡所適從。

translations.literal: He built those walled cities; their authority matched the capital; all followed imperial system with none to follow.
translations.idiomatic: He built those walled cities; their authority matched the capital; all followed imperial system with none to follow.

sentences.zh: 聽姑歸之言，惑邪臣之說，溺寵廢嫡，托付失所。

translations.literal: Listening to the words of the Empress Dowager, deluded by the speech of wicked ministers, he drowned favor and deposed the heir; entrustment and appointment lost their place.
translations.idiomatic: Listening to the words of the Empress Dowager, deluded by the speech of wicked ministers, he drowned favor and deposed the heir; entrustment and appointment lost their place.

sentences.zh: 滅父子之道，開昆弟之隙；

translations.literal: He extinguished the Way between father and son and opened the gap between elder and younger brothers;
translations.idiomatic: He extinguished the Way between father and son and opened the gap between elder and younger brothers;

sentences.zh: 縱其尋斧，翦伐本根。

translations.literal: allowing them to seek the axe, he cut down the root.
translations.idiomatic: allowing them to seek the axe, he cut down the root.

sentences.zh: 墳土未幹，子孫繼踵為戮；

translations.literal: Before the grave mound was dry, sons and grandsons followed one another in execution;
translations.idiomatic: Before the grave mound was dry, sons and grandsons followed one another in execution;

sentences.zh: 松槚才列，天下已非隋有。

translations.literal: pine and cypress had only just been set in rows and the realm was already no longer Sui's.
translations.idiomatic: pine and cypress had only just been set in rows and the realm was already no longer Sui's.

sentences.zh: 惜哉！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 跡其衰怠之源，稽其亂亡之兆，起自文皇，成於煬帝；

translations.literal: Tracing the source of his decline and slackness and examining the omens of disorder and ruin, it began with Emperor Wen and was completed under Emperor Yang;
translations.idiomatic: Tracing the source of his decline and slackness and examining the omens of disorder and ruin, it began with Emperor Wen and was completed under Emperor Yang;

sentences.zh: 所由來遠矣，非一朝一夕，其不祀忽諸，未為不幸也。

translations.literal: the origin was remote—not overnight; that his sacrifices suddenly ceased was not unlucky.
translations.idiomatic: the origin was remote—not overnight; that his sacrifices suddenly ceased was not unlucky.
